news.analysis: Cousins had a nice return to the Vikings in Week 10. He followed up with a tough game in Week 11. The veteran QB was fairly efficient with his passing, but he failed to find the end zone, unless the pick-six he threw late in the second quarter counts. Joking aside, Cousins will have better games, and a matchup with one of his former teams - the Falcons - awaits in Week 12. Cousins is right on the fringe of QB1 status in standard formats.
news.contents: Kirk Cousins completed 26-of-38 passes for 235 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
